subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should Control UI add @agent mention autocomplete now, and should the implementation reuse agents.list or introduce a shared composer-suggestion/API contract first?
rationale: This is a new user-facing composer capability and possible gateway API surface, while current agents.list already exposes the metadata proposed for a new directory endpoint and adjacent autocomplete work remains open.

options.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
options.body: Define a shared suggestion model first, then implement @agent mentions and keep custom-term suggestions compatible with the same UX contract.

options.title: Implement Narrow @Agent Mentions
options.body: Allow a focused @agent mention feature that reuses agents.list and leaves broader custom-term suggestions for later.

options.title: Defer Mention Chips
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer rich chips/contenteditable until maintainers prioritize larger composer architecture work.

recommendation.title: Scope Shared Composer Suggestions
recommendation.body: Define a shared suggestion model first, then implement @agent mentions and keep custom-term suggestions compatible with the same UX contract.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is tied to the slash-command composer UX history and the adjacent autocomplete triage, making them the best available product-surface owner from the evidence.
